### Epistemoloji ve eleştirel değerlendirme

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about knowledge concern what can be believed responsibly, what makes claims true, and when confidence should change. This domain applies general standards of justification to testimony and public information; scientific experimental design has its own domain.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Bir inancı neyin gerekçelendirdiğini ve kamusal bilgilerin nasıl değerlendirileceğini keşfet.

#### Kanıt ve tanıklık

Skills: 5

[evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Knowledge often depends on information supplied by other people or institutions. Source reliability, independence, and evidential fit require appraisal without treating every source as equally trustworthy.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Başkalarının aktardığı iddiaları ve kanıtları değerlendirmeyi öğren.

##### Epistemik adaletsizliği çözümlemek

[analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how prejudicial credibility judgments or unequal interpretive resources can wrong someone in their capacity as a knower, distinct from warranted critical assessment of testimony.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Güvenilirlik hakkındaki haksız yargıların insanların sesini nasıl duyuramaz hâle getirdiğini incele.

[checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether apparently agreeing accounts are genuinely independent or reproduce one underlying report.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Birbiriyle uyuşan kaynakların gerçekten bağımsız kanıtlar sunup sunmadığını kontrol et.

##### Bir iddiayı kanıtından ayırt etmek

[distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate what someone asserts from the observations, documents, or arguments presented to support it.

[distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts)

[deductiveReasoning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/deductiveReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Deduction concerns whether it is possible for premises to be true while a conclusion is false. Logical form is evaluated separately from whether the premises describe the world correctly.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Sonuçların verilen öncüllerden ne zaman zorunlu olarak çıktığını araştır.

##### Modus Ponens Uygulama

[applyModusPonens.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/applyModusPonens.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a consequent from a conditional and its antecedent without treating the inverse conditional as equivalent.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Şu kuralı uygula: A, B'yi gerektiriyorsa ve A doğruysa B sonucu çıkar.

##### Modus Tollens Uygulama

[applyModusTollens.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/applyModusTollens.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reject the antecedent of a conditional from the denial of its consequent, under the conditional as stated.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Bir koşulu ve sonucunun olumsuzluğunu kullanarak ön bileşeni reddet.

##### Tümdengelimsel Geçerliliği Değerlendirme

[assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a conclusion must hold if the premises hold, using logical structure rather than agreement with the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Tüm öncüller doğruyken sonucun yanlış olup olamayacağını denetle.

##### Geçerlilik ve Sağlamlığı Ayırt Etme

[distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a sound deductive argument requires both a valid inference and true premises.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Mantıksal olarak geçerli bir argümanın neden yanlış öncülleri olabileceğini anla.

##### Kategorik Kıyası Değerlendirme

[evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether relations among classes support the proposed conclusion, rather than relying on familiar subject matter.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Sınıflarla ilgili ifadelerin bir sonucu mantıksal olarak destekleyip desteklemediğini belirle.

##### İddialar Arasındaki Çelişkiyi Belirleme

[identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where commitments cannot all be true together under the same meanings and conditions.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Aynı koşullarda hepsi birden doğru olamayacak iddiaları fark et.

[propositionalLogic.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/propositionalLogic.data.ts)

### Metafizik

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[metaphysics.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/metaphysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysics examines the most general categories of reality, such as what exists, how things persist, and what makes events possible. Its conceptual questions differ from describing particular natural mechanisms in the sciences.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Varoluş, özdeşlik, gerçeklik, zaman ve olasılık hakkındaki felsefi soruları keşfet.

#### Nedensellik, zaman ve olasılık

**User-friendly description (tr):** Neden, zaman ve neler olabileceği hakkındaki felsefi görüşleri incele.

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims that could be otherwise and those held to be true in every relevant possible circumstance.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Olması mümkün olan şeyle zorunlu olarak doğru olması gereken şeyi ayırt et.

[philosophicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/philosophicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophy investigates conceptual, normative, and foundational questions whose answers require reasons rather than observation alone. This domain concerns the practices used to formulate, refine, and discuss such questions; it is distinct from the formal evaluation of arguments in Logic.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Anlam, değerler ve varsayımlar hakkındaki soruları gerekçeli tartışmalarla araştır.

Skills: 4

**User-friendly description (tr):** Açık tanımların ve iyi seçilmiş örneklerin felsefi düşünmeyi nasıl geliştirdiğini keşfet.

**Methodological description (English):** Specify relevant conditions or uses of a term such as freedom so interlocutors can determine what their disagreement concerns.

**User-friendly description (tr):** İnsanlar bir terimin kullanımı konusunda anlaşamadığında anlamını açıklığa kavuştur.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yanlış ele aldığı bir durum bularak tanımı sorgula.

[useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts)

[identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Jurisprudence considers what makes a norm legally valid, why legal institutions claim authority, and how rules should be interpreted. These questions are not limited to any country's current statutes or to political legitimacy in general.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Hukuk kurallarına neyin otorite kazandırdığını ve nasıl yorumlanmaları gerektiğini keşfet.

##### Hukuki Pozitivizmi Analiz Etmek

[analyzeLegalPositivism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeLegalPositivism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate accounts that identify valid law through social sources or institutional practices rather than making moral correctness a necessary condition of legal validity.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Hukukun geçerliliğinin ahlaki değerinden değil toplumsal kaynaklarından geldiği görüşünü incele.

##### Doğal Hukuk Kuramını Analiz Etmek

[analyzeNaturalLawTheory.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeNaturalLawTheory.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate theories that understand legal authority or validity as importantly connected to morality, distinguishing different versions of this connection.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Hukukun otoritesini ahlaki ilkelere bağlayan görüşleri karşılaştır.

##### Hukukun Üstünlüğünü Analiz Etmek

[analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine principles such as generality, accessibility, prospectivity, consistent application, and constraints on arbitrary power as grounds for evaluating a legal order.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yasaları açık ve öngörülebilir kılan, keyfî gücü sınırlayan ilkeleri keşfet.

##### Hukuki Yorum Kuramlarını Değerlendirmek

[evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how text, legislative purpose, precedent, and institutional role support competing interpretations of a legal provision without deciding a real legal dispute.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Metnin, amacın ve emsal kararların bir hukuk kuralının yorumunu nasıl etkilediğini düşün.

#### Siyasi Otorite

Skills: 4

[politicalAuthority.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/politicalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Institutions exercise collective power that requires justification. Political legitimacy, coercion, and obedience are distinct concepts.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Siyasi otoritenin yalnızca güçlü değil, hangi koşullarda meşru olduğunu incele.

##### Sivil İtaatsizliği Analiz Etmek

[analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the moral conditions, aims, and limits of nonviolent principled lawbreaking without equating legality with morality.

**User-friendly description (tr):** İlkelere dayanan şiddetsiz yasa ihlalinin ahlaki gerekçelerini tartış.

##### Toplum Sözleşmesi Gerekçelerini Karşılaştırmak

[compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternative accounts use consent, cooperation, security, or fairness to justify political obligations.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Kamu kurumlarının kural koyma yetkisini haklı gösteren gerekçeleri değerlendir.

##### Siyasi Otoritenin Meşruiyetini Değerlendirmek

[evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine reasons offered to justify the right to make binding public decisions, not merely whether an institution controls force.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yönetimi rıza, güvenlik veya işbirliğiyle haklı çıkaran gerekçeleri karşılaştır.

##### Devlet Zorlamasının Sınırlarını Değerlendirmek

[evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing grounds for restricting individual actions, such as preventing harm or protecting rights.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Kişisel özgürlüğe kısıtlamaların hangi durumlarda haklı olabileceğini düşün.

#### Kamusal Akıl ve Yurttaşlık Yaşamı

Skills: 4

[publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** People with incompatible values must still make shared decisions. Philosophical inquiry examines how disagreements can be handled under pluralism and institutional accountability.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Farklı değerlere sahip insanların herkesi etkileyen kararları nasıl gerekçelendirdiğini keşfet.

##### Demokratik Meşruiyeti Analiz Etmek

[analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the roles of participation, representation, minority protections, and accountability in justifying collective decisions.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Katılım, temsil ve hesap verebilirliğin demokrasiyi nasıl haklı çıkardığını düşün.

##### Ortak İyiye Dair Bir Gerekçeyi Değerlendirmek

[assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine who benefits, who bears costs, and whether a proposed collective interest disregards legitimate dissent.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Ortak iyi iddiasının kimin çıkarlarını temsil ettiğini incele.

##### Kamusal Gerekçelerle Özel Tercihleri Ayırt Etmek

[distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify justifications aimed at principles others can evaluate, rather than asserting that a personal desire must settle collective policy.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Başkalarının paylaşması gerekmeyen tercihlerle kamusal gerekçeleri ayır.

##### Siyasi Yükümlülük Görüşlerini Değerlendirmek

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider when citizens may have moral reasons to obey, criticize, or resist laws irrespective of mere fear of punishment.

**User-friendly description (tr):** İnsanların yasalara neden uyduğunu, itiraz ettiğini veya direndiğini keşfet.

#### Haklar ve Özgürlük

Skills: 4

[rightsAndLiberty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/rightsAndLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (tr):** İnsanların hangi hakları talep edebileceğini ve özgürlüğün ne anlama geldiğini keşfet.

##### Haklar Arasındaki Çatışmayı Analiz Etmek

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Önemli haklar arasındaki çatışmaların nasıl çözülebileceğini düşün.

##### Negatif ve Pozitif Özgürlüğü Ayırt Etmek

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Müdahaleden özgür olmayı etkili biçimde hareket edebilme gücüyle karşılaştır.

##### Haklarla Ayrıcalıkları Ayırt Etmek

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Kişinin hakkı olan bir talebi koşullu verilen ayrıcalıktan ayır.

##### Vicdan Özgürlüğünü Açıklamak

[explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (tr):** İnsanların dinî veya din dışı inançlara sahip olmasının neden özgür olması gerektiğini keşfet.

#### Teknoloji ve Toplum

Skills: 3

[technologyAndSociety.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/technologyAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Teknolojilerin insan eylemlerini ve toplumu nasıl etkilediğini analiz etmeyi öğren.

##### Teknolojik Sistemlerde İnsan Özerkliğini Analiz Etmek

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Teknolojinin kişinin kendi kararları üzerindeki denetimini ne zaman artırıp azalttığını keşfet.

##### Teknolojik Aracılığı Analiz Etmek

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Teknolojinin insanların seçeneklerini ve ilişkilerini nasıl değiştirdiğini incele.

##### Teknolojik Belirlenimciliği Değerlendirmek

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Teknolojik değişimin tek başına toplumların gelişimini belirleyip belirlemediğini sorgula.
